q: A train travels uniformly at $90\,\text{km/h}$. How far does it travel in $20\,\text{min}$?
a: The time in hours is $t = 20\,\text{min} = \tfrac{1}{3}\,\text{h}$, so $s = vt = 90\,\tfrac{\text{km}}{\text{h}} \cdot \tfrac{1}{3}\,\text{h} = 30\,\text{km}$. The units fit together when the time is in hours.
